1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.StarPolygonBoundary
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronStarCutSegments
3 
4 /-! The developed star boundary is exactly a finite union of explicit
5 closed straight segments. Degenerate segments retain all source copies.
6 This version uses the broader small-polyhedron route results. Where
7 nonoverlap is needed, it is stated explicitly as separation of the charts. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set Filter Topology
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
14   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16 
17 include size small_faces
18 
19 /-- Every listed segment is a cut copy, and every cut copy is on a listed segment. -/
20 theorem small_cutBoundaryImage_eq_segments {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
21     (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
22     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
23     charts.cutBoundaryImage = ⋃ e ∈ charts.boundarySegments, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 := by
24   ext x
25   constructor
26   · rintro ⟨d, b, cut, placed⟩
27     obtain ⟨s, side, t, at_b, value⟩ := ((charts.global d.adj).places_iff_ray b x).mp placed
28     obtain ⟨e, listed, on_segment⟩ := (small_triangle_cut_image size small_faces (charts.global d.adj)
29       cofacial side x).mp ⟨s, t, at_b.symm ▸ cut, value⟩
30     exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(charts.mem_boundarySegments e).mpr ⟨d, side, listed⟩, on_segment⟩⟩
31   · intro member
32     obtain ⟨e, member⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp member
33     obtain ⟨listed, on_segment⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp member
34     obtain ⟨d, side, listed⟩ := (charts.mem_boundarySegments e).mp listed
35     obtain ⟨s, t, cut, value⟩ := (small_triangle_cut_image size small_faces (charts.global d.adj)
36       cofacial side x).mpr ⟨e, listed, on_segment⟩
37     exact ⟨d, (charts.global d.adj).routes side s t, cut,
38       ((charts.global d.adj).places_iff_ray _ _).mpr ⟨s, side, t, rfl, value⟩⟩
39 
40 /-- The entire boundary is a finite union of whole straight cut segments. -/
41 theorem small_develop_frontier_eq_segments {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
42     (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (separated : charts.KitesSeparated)
43     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
44     frontier (range (fun c : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop c.val)) =
45       ⋃ e ∈ charts.boundarySegments, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 := by
46   rw [small_develop_frontier_eq_cutBoundaryImage size small_faces charts separated cofacial,
47     small_cutBoundaryImage_eq_segments size small_faces charts cofacial]
48 
49 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
